review_candidates.title: Oracle Exadata Senior Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Role Summary We are seeking a Senior Exadata Administrator with deep expertise across Oracle Exadata on-premises (X8M/X9M/X10M) and Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS/ExaCC) on OCI. This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Exadata environments from deployment, patching, and performance engineering to high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity management ensuring mission-critical Oracle database workloads run at peak performance and resilience. Key Responsibiliti
eligibility_evidence: Configure and tune Smart Scan, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), and Smart Flash Cache for optimal offload performance.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Description Role Summary We are seeking a Senior Exadata Administrator with deep expertise across Oracle Exadata on-premises (X8M/X9M/X10M) and Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS/ExaCC) on OCI. Required Skills & Experience 7–8 years of progressive experience in Oracle Database and infrastructure administration with a minimum of 4 years focused on Exadata platforms. Strong hands-on expertise with Exadata on-premises (X-series) including CellCLI, ExaCLI, dbaascli, ILOM, and InfiniBand/RoCE networking. Proficiency in Exadata patching lifecycle and tooling (opatchauto, PatchMgr, dbaascli).
